g.text: CHX10-Cre; Ddx41 fl/fl vs. littermate control, n = 3 per genotype. Every gene in the curated panels, sorted by fold change within its population.

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Cones, horizontal cells and retinal ganglion cells fall coherently; rod genes sit just above the library-scaling line, which is what a gain in share

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: looks like rather than induction. Reactive gliosis is the one population whose genes move by more than two-fold on their own.
